WITH consumption_by_year AS (
    SELECT
        c."segment" AS segment,
        SUBSTRING(ym."date" FROM 1 FOR 4) AS year,
        SUM(ym."consumption") AS total_consumption
    FROM "yearmonth" ym
    JOIN "customers" c ON c."customerid" = ym."customerid"
    WHERE c."currency" = 'EUR'
      AND SUBSTRING(ym."date" FROM 1 FOR 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
      AND c."segment" IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c."segment", SUBSTRING(ym."date" FROM 1 FOR 4)
),
pivoted AS (
    SELECT
        segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2012' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2013' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM consumption_by_year
    GROUP BY segment
),
pct AS (
    SELECT
        segment,
        consumption_2012,
        consumption_2013,
        ((consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) / NULLIF(consumption_2013, 0)) * 100 AS pct_increase
    FROM pivoted
)

    (SELECT segment FROM pct ORDER BY pct_increase DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AS biggest_increase_segment,
    (SELECT pct_increase FROM pct ORDER BY pct_increase DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AS biggest_increase_pct,
    (SELECT segment FROM pct ORDER BY pct_increase ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AS lowest_increase_segment,
